name: Tune a prompt with real tests, then keep versions
why: Turns a rough prompt into a clear version scored against your test cases, with versions kept, the same loop as the build, test and ship workflow.

name: Prompt and skill tuner
why: Tunes a prompt or skill against your own test cases one change per round, matching the test set and fix skill.

name: Harden an AI app against hijacked prompts and runaway bills
why: Adds defences and tests against hidden instructions plus spending caps, the code side of the prompt injection review.

name: Agent injection evidence review assistant
why: Writes safe injection test cases for your own agent and tracks retest evidence, run only with the owner's approval.

name: Extract a scanned document and verify key facts
why: Pulls facts from a scanned document and checks each against the page, a good companion to the extraction prompt and schema skill.

name: Product image spec writer
why: Writes a sourced product truth sheet and lock lines for every image prompt, the first step of a product image prompt set.

name: Brand-to-image prompt compiler
why: Turns brand, scene and product details into one image prompt with a model pick, for single images outside a full set.

name: Accurate product image ad maker
why: Writes an image prompt that keeps your real product and checks the result, matching the rule that images show the product as it is.

name: Image ad maker with exact text
why: Handles images that need word-perfect text, with a fix for each fault, for the text-in-image step.

name: Ad image generation and edit planner
why: Plans a batch of ad images with settings, edit requests and a change log, useful once a prompt set is approved.

name: Old vs new ad prompt scorer
why: Compares old and new ad prompts with a blind test, a quick way to settle which prompt is better.
